notes.title: Thank you, Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Hello, Stone Skippers!

As we head into this last day of the Next Fest, I wanted to thank everyone who played the demo and/or wishlisted Sidewards - it's awesome to see other folks excited about rocks jumping across water. I have a lot planned for the game, so please stay tuned to updates like these to stay in the loop. 

If you haven't already checked out my other game, [url=https://partner.steamgames.com/apps/landing/2745260]Swashbuckler's Xmas[/url], it's also got a playable demo up for the Next Fest. Think "a pirate plunders the North Pole, or tries to, at least" and take it about as seriously as you do your next plunker!
